"""New native infographic built ONLY inside the official Blender MCP host.
Waveform geometry derives from actual preserved PCM, not the old JPEG.
"""
import bpy,hashlib,json,wave,math
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('EVIDENCE_ROOT/trail-ecosystem-recovery');s=bpy.context.scene
assert not s.objects and (s.sequence_editor is None or not list(s.sequence_editor.strips))
receipt=ROOT/'hero-native-v2-readback.json';assert not receipt.exists()
manifest=json.loads((ROOT/'inputs/manifest.json').read_text());assets={Path(a['local_file']).stem:a for a in manifest['audio']}
assert len(assets)==17
for name,frames in [('environment_soft_wind_foliage_loop',960000),('music_sparse_tonal_loop',921600)]:
 with wave.open(str(ROOT/'inputs'/assets[name]['local_file'])) as check:
  assert check.getnframes()==frames and check.getframerate()==48000
waveforms=[]
for name in ['footstep_stone_01','environment_soft_wind_foliage_loop','music_sparse_tonal_loop']:
 entry=assets[name];p=ROOT/'inputs'/entry['local_file']
 assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==entry['sha256']
 with wave.open(str(p)) as w:
  assert w.getsampwidth()==3 and w.getframerate()==48000
  data=w.readframes(w.getnframes());assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==entry['original_render_pcm_sha256']
  raw=np.frombuffer(data,dtype=np.uint8).reshape(-1,3).astype(np.int32)
  samples=(raw[:,0]|raw[:,1]<<8|raw[:,2]<<16);samples=(samples^0x800000)-0x800000
  samples=samples.reshape(-1,w.getnchannels()).mean(axis=1)/8388608
  chunks=np.array_split(samples,600);low=np.array([c.min() for c in chunks]);high=np.array([c.max() for c in chunks])
  peak=max(abs(low).max(),abs(high).max());assert peak>0 and np.isfinite(peak)
  waveforms.append((name,low/peak,high/peak,entry['sha256']))
# Mutations begin only after complete source validation.
def srgb(hexcode):
 vals=[int(hexcode[i:i+2],16)/255 for i in (0,2,4)]
 return tuple(v/12.92 if v<=.04045 else ((v+.055)/1.055)**2.4 for v in vals)+(1,)
def mat(name,color):
 m=bpy.data.materials.new(name);m.diffuse_color=srgb(color);m.use_nodes=True
 ns=m.node_tree.nodes;ns.clear();e=ns.new('ShaderNodeEmission');e.inputs['Color'].default_value=srgb(color);e.inputs['Strength'].default_value=1
 out=ns.new('ShaderNodeOutputMaterial');m.node_tree.links.new(e.outputs[0],out.inputs['Surface']);return m
def mesh(name,verts,faces,material):
 me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name);me.from_pydata(verts,[],faces);me.update();o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me);s.collection.objects.link(o);o.data.materials.append(material);return o
def rect(name,x,y,w,h,z,material):return mesh(name,[(x,y,z),(x+w,y,z),(x+w,y+h,z),(x,y+h,z)],[(0,1,2,3)],material)
def text(name,body,x,y,size,material,width):
 d=bpy.data.curves.new(name,'FONT');d.body=body;d.size=size;d.align_y='BOTTOM_BASELINE';o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,d);s.collection.objects.link(o);o.location=(x,y,.15);d.materials.append(material);bpy.context.view_layer.update()
 if o.dimensions.x>width:d.size*=width/o.dimensions.x;bpy.context.view_layer.update()
 assert o.dimensions.x<=width+1e-5
 return o
bg=mat('Deep teal','0B1C23');panel=mat('Waveform panels','142F39');white=mat('Warm white','ECF3F0');muted=mat('Muted text','A8BFBE')
colors=[mat('Footstep amber','E7B975'),mat('Environment mint','85CFC4'),mat('Tonal lavender','ADA7D4')]
rect('Background',0,0,14.4,9.6,0,bg)
text('Identity','DCC-MCP / ORIGINAL AUDIO ASSET PACK',.65,8.95,.24,muted,13.1)
text('Title','TRAIL & AIR',.62,7.65,.95,white,12.9)
text('Subtitle','A quiet sonic palette for exploration.',.68,7.03,.28,muted,12.8)
for index,(name,low,high,source_hash) in enumerate(waveforms):
 y=5.35-index*1.32;material=colors[index]
 rect('Panel_'+name,3.5,y-.46,10.25,1.02,.02,panel)
 labels=['01  FOOTSTEPS','02  ENVIRONMENT','03  TONAL BED']
 text('Label_'+name,labels[index],.68,y+.16,.20,material,2.65)
 verts=[]
 for j in range(600):
  x=3.75+j/599*9.7;verts.extend([(x,y+.4*float(low[j]),.08),(x,y+.4*float(high[j]),.08)])
 faces=[(2*j,2*j+1,2*j+3,2*j+2) for j in range(599)]
 mesh('Waveform_'+name,verts,faces,material)
for x,big,small in [(.65,'17 ASSETS','12 FOOTSTEPS + 3 SFX'),(5.35,'2 LOOPS','20.0 s AIR / 19.2 s MUSIC'),(10.6,'48 kHz','24-BIT ORIGINAL PCM')]:
 text('Metric_'+big,big,x,1.15,.42,white,3.3);text('Detail_'+big,small,x,.86,.15,muted,3.25)
text('Boundary','3 REPRESENTATIVE WAVEFORMS / 17 ASSETS / DISPLAY-NORMALIZED AMPLITUDE',.65,.3,.18,muted,13.1)
camdata=bpy.data.cameras.new('InfographicCamera');cam=bpy.data.objects.new('InfographicCamera',camdata);s.collection.objects.link(cam);cam.location=(7.2,4.8,20);camdata.type='ORTHO';camdata.ortho_scale=14.4;camdata.dof.use_dof=False;s.camera=cam
s.render.engine='CYCLES';s.cycles.device='CPU';s.cycles.samples=16;s.cycles.use_denoising=False;s.render.threads_mode='FIXED';s.render.threads=2;s.render.resolution_x=1440;s.render.resolution_y=960;s.render.resolution_percentage=100
s.view_settings.view_transform='Standard';s.view_settings.look='None';s.view_settings.exposure=0;s.view_settings.gamma=1
s.render.image_settings.file_format='PNG';s.render.image_settings.color_mode='RGBA';s.render.image_settings.color_depth='8';s.render.film_transparent=False;s.frame_set(1)
report={'status':'native-infographic-built-not-rendered','script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'sources':[{'name':row[0],'sha256':row[3]} for row in waveforms],'waveform_bins':600,'normalization':'Each waveform panel normalized independently for display; not relative loudness','size':[1440,960],'engine':s.render.engine,'samples':s.cycles.samples,'denoising':s.cycles.use_denoising,'camera_dof':camdata.dof.use_dof,'mesh_count':sum(o.type=='MESH' for o in s.objects),'text_count':sum(o.type=='FONT' for o in s.objects),'old_jpeg_used':False}
receipt.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report))
